subject: Q3 OKR pulse: exec course-correct & dependency knock-on
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 OKR pulse: exec course-correct & dependency knock-on

Team —

Quick mid-quarter pulse and a short set of asks ahead of next week’s QBR prep. I reviewed the attached Q3_OKR_pulse_v1 and pulled the top 3 risk areas that need leadership clarifications or dependency commitments by end of week (EOW Friday 7/16):

1) Throughput & Cost Optimization (OKR 1):
- Current status: KR1.2 (reduce token cost / inference) is trending behind target — 58% of planned unit savings realized.
- Risk: Quantization rollout for priority models is blocked by vendor cert and bench infra changes.
- Ask: Infra + Runtime to commit to ETA for cert + canary window. Owner: Markus.

2) Dedicated Autoscaling and Capacity (OKR 2):
- Current status: Autoscale pilot launched but burst policy not yet tested under sustained load.
- Risk: If we can’t validate burst policy, Dedicated customers will face throughput SLO misses in peak.
- Ask: Jonas to confirm test plan and schedule for customer pilot with Nimbus (contact Nora P).

3) Release gating & Integration (OKR 3):
- Current status: Several product rollouts are gated on a single security questionnaire completion with Acme Cloud Solutions (procurement).
- Ask: Sales/Solution (Lauren) to confirm procurement timeline and whether we should escalate to legal to unblock.

Attachments: I attached the pulse spreadsheet and a short deployment-risk-log that pulls the open blockers. Please: 
- Update the spreadsheet with committed dates in the "Next Steps" column.
- Add a single line in the deployment-risk-log with owner, ETA, and mitigation option.

Immediate next steps (please reply to-thread with confirmations):
- Markus: certify quantization benching plan and propose canary week (date) 
- Jonas: confirm Nimbus pilot date & test owner
- Lauren: confirm procurement status for Acme and whether escalation needed

We need these confirmations to prepare the exec one-pager for Monday’s leadership sync. If anything requires an immediate escalation to Legal/CS, call me directly — otherwise please reply here.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_OKR_pulse_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1.2MB); deployment-risk-log.csv (csv, 48KB)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 OKR pulse: exec course-correct & dependency knock-on

Vanessa — thanks for the clear callouts. Quick replies inline: 

> Markus: certify quantization benching plan and propose canary week (date)
I agree we should re-scope KR1.2 to be a two-phase measure: Phase A (bench + internal canary) and Phase B (customer canary). If we land Phase A by 7/30 that still keeps us in a reasonable outcome for the quarter.

> Jonas: confirm Nimbus pilot date & test owner
I'll coordinate with Nimbus procurement and confirm whether Nora can sign the pilot NDAs this week. If procurement holds past 7/22 we should have a fallback plan to run an internal synthetic pilot with Jonas’ team.

> Lauren: confirm procurement status for Acme
I’ve pinged Acme procurement (attached infra-impact-notes.pdf which summarizes outstanding SOW questions). Short answer: they have one technical review call left and then a commercial approval — estimate 10 business days if nothing else pops. I recommend we flag legal now so we don’t get surprised.

Committed actions:
- I will escalate to Legal for Acme procurement if I don’t get a hard date by Monday EOD (7/12).
- I will get Nora’s procurement point-of-contact and share calendar availability for a pilot week by Monday.

Attaching infra-impact-notes.pdf (brief)

- Lauren
Director, Solutions & GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 OKR pulse: exec course-correct & dependency knock-on

Vanessa / Lauren — short technical update and commitment:

- Root cause: The vendor cert for the new int8 kernels requires a minor kernel patch plus memory-accounting tests. We have the patch; the outstanding item is the test harness to validate KV cache behavior under 4k seq lengths.
- Plan: I can prioritize the harness work and have an internal canary run by 7/29. Customer canary (Phase B) requires Nimbus sign-off and a deployment window (2 days) — Jonas, can you confirm test window availability week of 8/2?
- Commitment: Internal canary by 7/29; customer canary target week of 8/2–8/9, contingent on Nimbus availability.
- Blockers: we need SUP-1234 (infra resource allocation) to be moved to "approved" in Jira and a 2x engineer-day allocation this sprint. I added the SUP ticket link below.

On the cost side: this approach reduces risk of a wide rollout and preserves our throughput targets, but it pushes full unit-cost realization into early Q4 for the models in scope. Recommend we capture the KR rescope as Lauren suggested (Phase A/B) and call out the shifted baseline in the QBR one-pager.

Markus
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

References: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-1234

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 OKR pulse: exec course-correct & dependency knock-on

Thanks all — this is helpful and actionable. Summary / confirmed next steps for the QBR one-pager and leadership sync: 

1) KR1.2 (Throughput & Cost) — rescope to Phase A (internal verification) + Phase B (customer canary). Markus to own Phase A completion target 7/29. Lauren will mark the KR update in the tracker and I’ll reflect the shifted baseline in the one-pager.

2) Autoscale pilot — Jonas to propose a specific Nimbus pilot window by Monday 7/12. If Nimbus procurement delays, we fallback to an internal synthetic pilot week starting 7/26.

3) Procurement / Acme — Lauren to escalate to Legal if Acme does not provide a firm commercial approval date by Monday EOD 7/12.

4) Blocker resolution — Rishi to follow SUP-1234 and confirm resource approval; if not approved we will surface the resource risk in the QBR.

Please update the two attached files with your confirmed dates and owners by EOD Friday 7/16 so I can lock the slides. If any item needs an immediate exec escalation (credits, SLA exceptions, or external procurement pressure), call me. Otherwise I’ll take this into the leadership sync on Monday.

Appreciate the speed here.

—Vanessa
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
